# The Overstory

Finished it in February. A novel told through nine people whose lives end up tied to trees and to a protest against logging old-growth forest.

## What stayed with me

The idea that trees communicate and share resources through fungal networks underground. The book made me notice the oak at the end of our street differently.

## Quotes I marked

"The best arguments in the world won't change a person's mind. The only thing that can do that is a good story."

Related: the oak is in my [[Garden Log]].
